Question: Let \(v,\) \(w,\) \(x,\) \(y,\) and \(z\) be the degree measures of the five angles of a pentagon. Suppose \(v\lt w\lt x\lt y\lt z\) and \(v,\) \(w,\) \(x,\) \(y,\) \(z\) form an arithmetic sequence. Find the value of \(x.\)
